scope: Independent read-only audit and Editor-only portrait QA tool. Runtime evidence is produced separately by the parent agent; this report does not claim that a capture has passed.

findings.evidence: RecoveredBoardFraming previously returned immediately for aspect < 1; cropping was not prevented.
findings.resolution: Portrait gameplay agent has added a HUD-free viewport fit. Actual mesh-vertex verification is still required in Unity.

findings.evidence: Native UI reads Screen.width/height and uses CanvasScaler. A portrait RenderTexture alone does not prove native portrait reflow.
findings.resolution: Capture is tied to the actual Game View resolution, records it, and aborts if it changes mid-suite.

findings.evidence: Native UI animations set transforms when menus, solution or completion panels are shown.
findings.resolution: Export inventories all position/scale/size/anchor animation bindings. Runtime checks wait after transitions.

findings.evidence: Initial six proposed levels missed the default Levely5 gameplay scene.
findings.resolution: gm1 added. The suite now covers all four gameplay scenes; menus cover all five other scenes.

findings.evidence: Desktop Game View normally reports the entire screen as safe. It does not simulate an actual device notch by itself.
findings.resolution: All active control rectangles are checked against actual Screen.safeArea. Device Simulator or device hardware is needed for additional real notch evidence.

findings.evidence: Inactive modal panels and masked scrolling pages can intentionally sit outside the viewport.
findings.resolution: Static audit inventories them without failing. Runtime tests skip masked fully-offscreen children and background controls behind active modals.

runtimeAssertions: Actual Game View is portrait and unchanged during the run
Active unmasked controls stay inside Screen.safeArea
Targets are at least approximately 44 units in a 720-wide design reference
EventSystem center rays reach the expected control or a descendant
Every visible structural mesh vertex is inside the exposed HUD-free PlayfieldViewport and near/far clipping range
No missing active text fonts or runtime Error/Exception/Assert
limits: Button rectangle overlap and controls entering the reserved playfield are reported as warnings for visual review because intentional slider/gesture container overlaps can exist.
Native win/flow/input/fountain invariants remain covered by existing gameplay validation; the visual suite never treats geometry matching as proof of native win behavior.
The suite changes normal Play-mode navigation and applies saved solutions only to gather initial/solution view evidence. It does not write production scenes or assets.
